description: Concrete figures from company filings, bank reports, tax returns, government awards and official registers; each value carries the filing it came from and a citable URL. One metric for one entity ACROSS TIME, with the gaps made explicit. Fits questions about a period, a development or a comparison of years — 'how did X change', 'from 2018 to 2022', 'over the last decade'. Years without a measurement are returned with status 'no_observation' and a null value; they are gaps, not values, and no neighbouring year stands in for them. Every point carries its own fact_url, its source and its status (observed | derived | estimated | imputed | superseded). One call replaces repeated get_facts calls and, unlike get_facts, shows a missing year as a gap instead of simply leaving out the row.

entity.description: name or ID, e.g. 'cik:320193', 'Kings County, New York'
